title: Far Infrared Irradiation for Management and Treating of Parkinson's Disease (PD)
brief_summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a degenerative disorder of the central nervous system that often impairs the sufferer's motor skills and speech. This study will investigate the use of far infrared radiation to manage, control and treat PD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* People with Parkinson's Disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
